stories.title: Cabinet urged to heed public feeling over Saltney primary school merger
stories.summary: Flintshire’s Cabinet has been urged to think carefully after governors, teachers and of parents overwhelmingly opposed plans to merge two Saltney schools. stories.title: Helen Jenner appointed new leader of Reform UK Wales
stories.summary: Helen Jenner MS has been appointed the new leader of Reform UK Wales. stories.title: Airbus to create 480 jobs in £150m Broughton wing plant conversion
stories.summary: Airbus is investing £150 million to convert its former A380 wing production line at Broughton into a new facility building wings for the A321. stories.title: Mold theatre to stage A Doll’s House, The Secret Garden and new Lucie Lovatt thriller
stories.summary: Theatr Clwyd in Mold has announced its spring 2027 season, featuring three new productions.
